name: Cyclonian

angles.text: Defeating the wind lord Cyclonian is a defining trial of strength, proving martial mastery by claiming his whirlwind heart to forge a potent weapon.

faq.answer: Cyclonian is a powerful elemental wind lord. He represents a severe elemental threat that has long been watched by observers waiting for a champion strong enough to challenge and defeat him.
Cyclonian is summoned to be challenged and slain by a worthy champion. Defeating the wind lord allows a proven fighter to claim his whirlwind heart, which can then be infused into a powerful weapon.
The Whirlwind Heart is the core essence of the wind lord Cyclonian. When torn from the defeated elemental, its tempestuous energies can be forged directly into a weapon of great martial power.
A dedicated watcher has spent ages keeping vigil over the site, searching endlessly for a true champion capable of toppling the elemental lord and mastering his tempestuous heart.
Summoning Cyclonian requires gathering specific rare reagents recorded on a special parchment, which serve to draw the wind lord out into the world so he can be contested.
A champion who gathers the necessary components, summons Cyclonian, and slays him earns a weapon infused with the latent fury of the elemental's whirlwind heart.
faq.q: What weapon is forged from Cyclonian?

sections.body: Cyclonian is a raging elemental wind lord whose presence commands reverence and caution. For ages, an attentive watcher has kept vigil over the summoning site, waiting for a combatant possesses enough raw martial prowess to challenge and destroy this tempestuous entity.
sections.title: The Slumbering Wind Lord

sections.body: Calling forth Cyclonian requires a ritual of summoning using rare materials detailed upon a special parchment. Once summoned, the wind lord must be faced in direct combat, testing whether the challenger is truly a champion or merely another victim of his howling gale.
sections.title: Summoning the Tempest

sections.body: The ultimate goal of confronting the wind lord is to claim his whirlwind heart. Once severed from the vanquished elemental, the heart's fierce elemental energies can be bound and infused into a weapon fit for an accomplished champion.
sections.title: The Whirlwind Heart

summary: Cyclonian is a mighty wind lord whose defeat has been sought for ages. To challenge him, a champion must gather the components required to summon the elemental and strike him down to claim his whirlwind heart. Defeating the wind lord allows the heart's power to be infused into a formidable weapon.
